name: IT Workshop
topics: Introduction to R: Features, Installation and Packages
What is R? Explain its features, applications and advantages over other languages, and the steps to install it.
What are R packages? How do you install and load a package such as ggplot2?
Objects, Data Types, Variables and Special Values
What are the data types in R? Write R code for numeric, complex, character and integer data types.
What are objects in R? Describe the role of special values Inf, NaN and NULL.
Vectors and Vector Operations
What is a vector in R? Explain the types of vectors and vector operations with examples.
Write an R program to calculate the mode of the elements in a vector.
Data Structures: Lists, Matrices, Arrays, Data Frames
Explain the data structures in R (list, matrix, array, data frame) with examples.
Differentiate between matrices and data frames in R and explain matrix operations.
Control Statements and Basic Programs
What are control statements in R? Explain any three with examples.
Write R programs to check an Armstrong number, print squares and cubes up to n, count vowels in a string, and print the Fibonacci series.
Operators and Built-in Functions
Write an R program demonstrating arithmetic, logical, relational and assignment operators.
Explain built-in mathematical and summarising functions in R with examples; how is R used as a calculator?
Data Frames: Manipulation, Subsetting and Cleaning
Create a data frame of students, extract rows with score above 75 and add a Grade column based on the score.
Explain the subset() call in the given code; how are datasets combined, loaded and saved in R? What are the steps of data cleaning?
Statistics in R: T-test, ANOVA and Linear Models
Explain the different types of T-tests. What is the difference between a T-test and ANOVA?
Explain a linear model in R with an example; differentiate discrete and continuous data and uniform vs exponential distributions.
Data Visualisation in R
Write an R program to create a boxplot for the mtcars dataset and explain it.
Explain histograms, bar charts, pie charts, line charts and scatter plots in R with syntax.
